async def act(page):
    # Click the 'New project' link to navigate to the new project creation page
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="New project").click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill in the project name

    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
    # Wait for the repository to be created
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
